blocks.text: [Updated Sept. 30, 2026, 2:10 p.m.] MANILA, Philippines — No shooting took place at a high school in Isulan, Sultan Kudarat, after a ‘loud sound’ was reported on the premises, the province’s governor said Wednesday. According to Sultan Kudarat Governor Datu Pax Ali Mangudadatu, the loud sound reported was likely caused by faulty wiring, and not by a firearm. “There was no shooting incident at Isulan National High School,” said Mangudadatu in a statement.
